description: Phase 3 Group A (Route Handler Track) — Minimal streaming baseline, context injection, and history persistence. All stories touch src/app/api/chat/[projectId]/route.ts. Runs in parallel with Group B (UI track). Base branch: ralph/phase-2-project-management.

userStories.title: Install AI SDK dependencies and create minimal streaming route handler
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a minimal streaming route handler with verified end-to-end streaming before adding DB or context complexity, so I can confirm the SDK auth and streaming transport work correctly in isolation.
acceptanceCriteria: Run `npm show @ai-sdk/google-vertex version` to confirm the current version before installing — note in progress.txt if major version differs from 1.x
Install `ai` and `@ai-sdk/google-vertex` packages
Create `src/app/api/chat/[projectId]/route.ts` with `export const runtime = 'nodejs'` as the FIRST line after imports — this is non-negotiable for gcloud ADC auth
Route exports a `POST` handler that reads `{ messages }` from the request body
Path A: use `streamText` from `ai` and the vertex provider from `@ai-sdk/google-vertex` with a hardcoded prompt 'Respond with just the phrase: STREAM OK'
Return a streaming response using `result.toDataStreamResponse()`
Add response headers: `X-Accel-Buffering: no`, `Cache-Control: no-cache`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`
Test: POST to http://localhost:3000/api/chat/test-id with `{ messages: [] }` returns a streaming response containing 'STREAM OK' tokens
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes

If Path A fails with ADC auth errors in the SDK bridge layer, switch immediately to Path B: use `@google-cloud/vertexai` direct SDK with a `pull`-based `ReadableStream` constructor wrapping the AsyncIterator — do NOT debug the wrapper
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: `export const runtime = 'nodejs'` must be present — edge runtime breaks gcloud ADC auth (uses Node.js fs APIs). Path A first: `@ai-sdk/google-vertex` + `streamText`. If ADC auth fails inside the SDK bridge layer, switch to Path B immediately: `@google-cloud/vertexai` direct SDK + manual ReadableStream bridge. Path B: use pull-based constructor wrapping AsyncIterator, NOT `for await...of` in `start` callback. PHASE 1 VERIFIED: The working model for the `socratoys` GCP project is `gemini-2.5-flash` — `gemini-2.0-flash` returns 404. Check `src/app/api/smoke-test/route.ts` for the confirmed model string.

userStories.title: Wire full context injection — system prompt and megatrend docs into systemInstruction
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the FUND II system prompt and all megatrend knowledge base documents injected into every Vertex AI request so the agent behaves according to the pedagogical spec.
acceptanceCriteria: Import `getSystemContext` from `@/lib/context` in the chat route handler
Call `getSystemContext()` on each request and pass the result as `system` (Path A `streamText`) or `systemInstruction` (Path B direct SDK) — NOT as an entry in the `messages`/`contents` array
Verify the system prompt is NOT appearing as a user or model message in the Vertex AI contents array
Add a debug log statement (temporary, remove before commit) that prints `Context length: ${context.length}` — confirm it is > 10000 chars in dev server logs
Remove the debug log and commit clean code
Test: POST to the chat route with a message asking 'What are the FUND II megatrends?' — response should reference the megatrend content from the injected docs, not give a generic answer
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes
userStories.notes: Vertex AI convention: system prompt goes in `systemInstruction` (Path B) or `system` param of `streamText` (Path A) — NOT in the `contents` array. `@/lib/context` is server-only (has `import 'server-only'`). Prisma client at `@/generated/prisma/client` (Prisma 7 — not `@prisma/client`).

userStories.title: Implement chat history persistence with rolling window
userStories.description: As a student, I need my conversation history to survive browser refreshes and tab closes so I can return to a project and pick up where I left off.
acceptanceCriteria: At the start of the POST handler, load all messages for the given `projectId` from Prisma: `prisma.message.findMany({ where: { projectId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } })`

Apply rolling window: preserve the first 2 turns (4 messages: 2 user + 2 model) and the last 20 turns (40 messages) — total cap 44 messages — never drop messages from the end, always drop from the middle
Format history as Vertex AI `contents` array: `[{ role: 'user' | 'model', parts: [{ text }] }]` — role values must be 'user' and 'model' (not 'assistant')
Persist the incoming user message to the DB BEFORE calling the streaming model — use `await prisma.message.create({ data: { projectId, role: 'user', content: userMessage } })`
Path A: use the `onFinish` callback of `streamText` to persist the complete assistant message after streaming ends
Path B: collect streamed chunks into a buffer and persist via `prisma.message.create` after the stream closes
Test: send 3 messages to a project, restart dev server, send a 4th message — the model should have context from all prior messages
Test: DELETE the project via API and verify all its messages are also deleted (cascade delete from Phase 2 schema)
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes
userStories.notes: Role values are 'user' and 'model' for Vertex AI — not 'assistant'. Persist user message BEFORE streaming starts to avoid losing it on stream errors. Persist assistant message AFTER stream closes. Rolling window: keep first 2 turns + last 20 turns. Import prisma from `@/lib/prisma` (singleton). PRISMA 7 NOTE: generated client is at `@/generated/prisma/client` — not `@prisma/client`.
